name: Chamber of the Guildpact
description: A ruined chamber in a memory-prison where the Guildpact is held.

pages_say.description: The newly built official sanctum of the Living Guildpact.
The Ravnican seat of the Living Guildpact where Gideon collapses at the foot of the steps.
Where Jace holds appointments as the Living Guildpact.
The center of Ravnican law, whose roof the Phyrexians destroy.
A place whose imaginary ruins hold Jace's former sanctum within a memory-prison.
A ruined chamber in a memory-prison where the Guildpact is held.
A Ravnican chamber whose apartment Jace's pocket plane replicates.
